purpose: Define explicit parent relations for IdentityCore subjects so IAM/identity hierarchy is represented canonically rather than inferred from organization names, accounts or filesystem/runtime placement.

value.relation_rule: Parent relation is an explicit canonical relation between exact IdentityCore identities.
value.multi_rule: Whether an identity may have one or multiple parent relations is explicit per owning policy/context.
value.organization_rule: Organization hierarchy may use parent relations without changing child identity.
value.person_rule: A person's organization/employment relation is not automatically an IdentityCore parent unless explicitly modeled as such.
value.authority_rule: Identity parenthood does not automatically grant AccessCore authority over the child.
value.inheritance_rule: No credential, MeritCore, PortfolioCore or authorization state is inherited merely from parenthood.
